verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the backend is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only New Relic's hosted platform, agents and CLIs. Nothing documents a self-hosted deployment of the full stack, a production architecture for running it yourself, or an upgrade path. Agents, OpenTelemetry and the Terraform-managed Agent Control all send data to New Relic and do not make the backend self-hostable.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path
